purpose: Fixed-model development alternative after immutable frozen-core new8 result; not a new holdout accuracy claim or default adoption.

fixed_parameters.source_frames: actual source-derived cached960 BGR, exact source PTS and SHA verified
fixed_parameters.preprocessing: archived adapter unchanged: fullclip median +8RGB, cv2 INTER_CUBIC, 512x288, NCHW/255

selection_rule: After explicit auditor release choose first2 distinct scorable failed sources from the released case list, favor shorter full clips if ordering not prescribed. Do not select ROI or time window using references.
scope_limit: Tracking/events/identity/decision replay over saved detections and actual pixels; native source-contact refinement and output video generation are not rerun. Record this scope; do not call replay fresh full-pipeline validation.
stopping_rule: If both first cases show no useful actual target candidate/path evidence, stop. If one helps, report to root before broadening protected cases.
